lineage.reason: On a lost run, 'a very expensive nap' mocks the failure itself, i.e. the player's performance, rather than one of Rook's plans; the 'Well.' opener also softens Vesna's clipped style.
lineage.before: Well. That was a very expensive nap.
lineage.after: Another plan joins the Ceres job.

lineage.reason: Console drop is a Rigs action, so the line is aimed at intruders and must be bureaucratic, not propaganda (label and text both wrong); it also presents the Rigs' console as a Kessler-Voss product, against the lore mechanic table. Change both the label (to bureaucratic) and the text.
lineage.before: Kessler-Voss Smart Consoles: innovation, delivered straight to your doorstep!
lineage.after: Foreign device registered on claim network. Entry logged for review.

lineage.reason: The chest is for the intruders, so propaganda to them breaks the bureaucratic-toward-threats register, and 'valued guests' welcomes trespassers instead of treating them as unauthorized personnel. Change both the label (to bureaucratic) and the text.

lineage.after: Unattended cargo flagged. Removal will be recorded as theft.

lineage.reason: Bureaucratic register matches the label, but 'Compliance is mandatory' demands the player comply, i.e. stop, instead of stating what the company does.
